products.overview: Released in February 2014, XY Base Set launched the XY era of the Pokémon TCG. The set introduced Fairy-type Pokémon to the English game and featured cards such as Venusaur-EX, Blastoise-EX, Emolga-EX, and Yveltal-EX.

products.overview: Released in May 2014, Flashfire is the second main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set is best known for its Charizard focus, including Mega Charizard-EX and Charizard-EX, alongside other Fire-type support and popular ultra rare cards.

Released in August 2014, Furious Fists is the third main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set heavily emphasized Fighting-type Pokémon and featured cards such as Lucario-EX, Mega Lucario-EX, Seismitoad-EX, and Heracross-EX.

Released in November 2014, Phantom Forces is the fourth main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set is known for its dark theme and standout cards such as Gengar-EX, Mega Gengar-EX, Dialga-EX, and the Silver Bangle-era style of competitive support cards.

Released in February 2015, Primal Clash is the fifth main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. Inspired by Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, the set introduced Primal Reversion cards such as Primal Kyogre-EX and Primal Groudon-EX.

Released in May 2015, Roaring Skies is the sixth main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set became especially popular for Rayquaza-EX, Mega Rayquaza-EX, Shaymin-EX, and its lasting relevance in both collecting and competitive play.

Released in August 2015, Ancient Origins is the seventh main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set featured Hoopa-EX, Mega Tyranitar-EX, and other cards inspired by Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire lore and Legendary Pokémon themes.

Released in November 2015, BREAKthrough is the eighth main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set introduced the BREAK mechanic and is known for cards such as Mewtwo-EX, Mega Mewtwo-EX, and a variety of early BREAK evolution cards.

Released in February 2016, BREAKpoint is the ninth main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set continued the BREAK mechanic and featured cards such as Gyarados-EX, Darkrai-EX, Greninja BREAK, and additional competitive support pieces.

Released in May 2016, Fates Collide is the tenth main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set featured Zygarde-EX, Alakazam-EX, Umbreon-EX, and Lugia BREAK, combining Generation VI themes with fan-favorite Pokémon.
Released in August 2016, Steam Siege is the eleventh main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set featured Volcanion-EX, Magearna-EX, dual-type Pokémon, and a mix of Kalos and Steam-era themed cards.

Released in November 2016, Evolutions is the twelfth and final main XY-era Pokémon TCG expansion. The set celebrated the franchise's history with a modern reimagining of the original Base Set and became especially popular for its Charizard line and nostalgic appeal.
